title: Render a tree as Haskell
description: You can follow visitor methods that construct Haskell expression text.

steps.description: The classes describe expression nodes. Visitor selects a method from the node's class name, and ast binds x to 3 around a nested calculation.
Numbers become text and variables keep their names. Binary operations gain parentheses, with a separate div form for division.

steps.question: Which Haskell form encloses the value and body of Let?
steps.answer: The visitor emits let name = value in body inside parentheses.

steps.description: The other methods format let, conditional, lambda, and application expressions. Each recursively obtains text for its child nodes.
The displayed text is (let x = 3 in ((x * 2) + 1)). The GHCi line is a verification comment rather than an executed call in this snippet.
